title: Sliding-Window Distributed API Rate Limiter
description: Implement a Redis-backed sliding window rate limiter per API key with burst allowances and header reporting.
explicit_requirements: Enforce 100 req/min rate limit per API key
derived_requirements: Include X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and Retry-After headers
Use atomic Redis sorted sets for sliding window timestamps
Graceful fallback to local token bucket if Redis connection drops

required_behavior: Accurately compute rolling window count within 1ms precision
forbidden_behavior: Resetting window counter at fixed minute boundaries (fixed window bug)
Crashing proxy when cache is offline

failure_taxonomy.description: Fixed window boundary allows 2x burst across minute turnover.

ground_truth_rationale: API gateway rate limiting protects downstream microservices from denial of service.
